package.description: Connects an EEG headset to DedAI, streaming brain signals over a local WebSocket via BrainFlow.

en-US.description: Connects an EEG headset to DedAI, streaming brain signals over a local WebSocket via BrainFlow.
en-US.longDescription: DedAI Bridge is a small desktop app that relays EEG data from a research headset (OpenBCI, Unicorn, Mentalab, and other BrainFlow-supported boards) into the DedAI brain-driven music platform over a secure, scoped local WebSocket. Pick a headset, confirm signal quality, and pair it with your DedAI session.
en-US.name: DedAI Bridge
